local function playSong(songId)
	local args = {
		"https://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=" .. tostring(songId)
	}
	game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Inventory"):WaitForChild("PlaySong"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

-- ระบบ เปิด/ปิด UI
-- ============================================
local isOpen = false

local function toggleUI()
	isOpen = not isOpen
	mainFrame.Visible = isOpen
	
	if isOpen then
		-- Animation เปิด
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 280, 0, 350)
		TweenService:Create(mainFrame, TweenInfo.new(0.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Back), {
			Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 400)
		}):Play()
	end
end

toggleButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleUI)
closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleUI)

-- ============================================
-- รองรับการปัดเพื่อปิดบนมือถือ (Swipe down)
-- ============================================
local touchStartY = 0

mainFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		touchStartY = input.Position.Y
	end
end)

mainFrame.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local deltaY = input.Position.Y - touchStartY
		if deltaY > 100 then -- ปัดลงเกิน 100px
			toggleUI()
		end
	end
end)

-- ============================================
-- รองรับปุ่ม Back บน Android / ปุ่ม Escape บน PC
-- ============================================
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
	if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
		if isOpen then
			toggleUI()
		end
	end
end)
